results.query: Number of patients grouped by gender and ethnicity.

metadata.expected_output: WITH gen_temp1 AS ( SELECT concept_id, concept_name AS gender FROM concept WHERE domain_id = 'Gender' AND standard_concept = 'S' ), eth_temp1 AS ( SELECT concept_id, concept_name AS ethnicity FROM concept WHERE domain_id = 'Ethnicity' AND standard_concept = 'S' ) SELECT COALESCE(gen_temp1.gender, 'Unknown') AS gender, COALESCE(eth_temp1.ethnicity, 'Unknown') AS ethnicity, COUNT(DISTINCT pe1.person_id) AS number_of_patients FROM person AS pe1 LEFT JOIN gen_temp1 ON pe1.gender_concept_id = gen_temp1.concept_id LEFT JOIN eth_temp1 ON pe1.ethnicity_concept_id = eth_temp1.concept_id GROUP BY gen_temp1.gender, eth_temp1.ethnicity;

results.sql_query:
WITH gender_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name AS gender_name
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE domain_id = 'Gender' AND standard_concept = 'S'
),
ethnicity_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name AS ethnicity_name
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE domain_id = 'Ethnicity' AND standard_concept = 'S'
)
SELECT COALESCE(gc.gender_name, 'Unknown') AS gender,
       COALESCE(ec.ethnicity_name, 'Unknown') AS ethnicity,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.person p
LEFT JOIN gender_concepts gc ON p.gender_concept_id = gc.concept_id
LEFT JOIN ethnicity_concepts ec ON p.ethnicity_concept_id = ec.concept_id
GROUP BY gc.gender_name, ec.ethnicity_name;

results.sql_query:
WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '313782' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361757' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.drug_exposure de1
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de2 ON de1.person_id = de2.person_id
WHERE de1.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_hierarchy)
  AND de2.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_hierarchy)
  AND CAST(
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
      CAST(GREATEST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
      CAST(LEAST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 30;

  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '847630' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1483571' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (

  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1

),

  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de1.person_id) AS patient_count

JOIN omop.drug_exposure de2 ON de1.person_id = de2.person_id
WHERE de1.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_concepts)
  AND de2.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_concepts)
  AND CAST(
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
      CAST(GREATEST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -

results.sql_query:
WITH
  drug1_source AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '451473' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
  ),
  drug1_mapped AS (
    SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
    FROM drug1_source ds
    JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
  ),
  drug1_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM drug1_mapped dm
    JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  ),
  drug2_source AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '313782' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
  ),
  drug2_mapped AS (
    SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
    FROM drug2_source ds
    JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
  ),
  drug2_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM drug2_mapped dm
    JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  ),
  drug3_source AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361757' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
  ),
  drug3_mapped AS (
    SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
    FROM drug3_source ds
    JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
  ),
  drug3_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM drug3_mapped dm
    JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM (
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_hierarchy)
  INTERSECT
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_hierarchy)
  INTERSECT
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_hierarchy)
) AS intersect_patients;

WITH oxycodone_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept

  FROM acetaminophen_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
heparin_source AS (

  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '5224' AND invalid_reason IS NULL

heparin_mapped AS (

results.sql_query:
WITH
cond1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '44054006' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '59621000' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '836439001' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM (
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond1_concepts)
  INTERSECT
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond2_concepts)
  INTERSECT
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond3_concepts)
) AS intersect_patients;

results.sql_query:
WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1740467' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1049621' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patient_count FROM (
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_hierarchy)
  INTERSECT
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_hierarchy)
) AS intersect_patients;
